response.justification: Well above the 6+ year bar with ~15 years of full-stack work and recent, directly relevant experience in TypeScript/Node.js, React, MongoDB, AWS and Kubernetes, plus current hands-on AI-agent/MCP tooling work — a specific requirement that most candidates will not meet. Strong testing culture (TDD, authored a test runner and assertion library, taught Selenium/CI courses) and a CS degree round out the core qualifications. Gaps are mostly stack-specific rather than fundamental: no explicit Nest.js, Vitest/Jest, Kotlin, or PostgreSQL experience, and frontend work skews toward Ember rather than deep React. Given the breadth and polyglot track record, these are likely quick ramp-ups and worth probing in an interview.
strengths: Deep TypeScript/Node.js + AWS/K8s full-stack experience across 15 years
Current AI-agent and MCP tooling work matches a hard-to-fill requirement
Exceptional testing/craftsmanship background: TDD, CI/CD, authored test tooling
concerns: No explicit Nest.js, Vitest/Jest, or Playwright experience listed
Frontend depth skews Ember.js; React exposure appears limited to one role
Kotlin absent and relational DB (PostgreSQL) experience only implied via 'SQL'

key_factors.factor: Missing Nest.js and named test frameworks
